Here, in the warm glow of a developer's laptop, lives one of nature's most remarkable creatures.
It is Friday afternoon. The human has a great many tokens left... and six terminals it has quite forgotten about.
So it does the only sensible thing. It writes one task... and releases the minions.
Watch closely. No manager. No stand-up meeting. They simply... talk.
A message here. A reply there. Each one knows precisely what the others are up to.
Here, a young fox claims the login bug. The cat, wisely, backs away... and takes the flaky test instead.
Within minutes, teams have formed. Nobody asked for a hierarchy. Nobody ever does.
And, like all proud creatures, they display their work.
The human observes from a safe distance. Scrolling. Occasionally nodding.
But when a minion is truly stuck... it raises its hand, and asks.
A behaviour almost never seen in the wild.
As the hour ends, the swarm settles. Every token accounted for. Nothing ran that the human did not allow.
And now... a nice cup of tea.
